category_title.ar: الجيوسياسة الرقمية العالمية والحوكمة التكنولوجية السيادية
category_title.de: Globale digitale Geopolitik und souveräne Technologie-Governance
category_title.en: Global Digital Geopolitics & Sovereign Tech Governance

example_sentence.de: Digitale Souveränität bedeutet die Fähigkeit eines Staates, seine digitale Infrastruktur und Datenflüsse autonom zu kontrollieren.
example_sentence.ar: تَعْنِي السِّيَادَةُ الرَّقْمِيَّةُ قُدْرَةَ الدَّوْلَةِ عَلَى التَّحَكُّمِ المُسْتَقِلِّ فِي بِنْيَتِهَا التَّحْتِيَّةِ الرَّقْمِيَّةِ وَتَدَفُّقَاتِ بَيَانَاتِهَا.
example_sentence.en: Digital sovereignty denotes the capacity of a nation to autonomously control its digital infrastructure and data flows.

example_sentence.de: Europas Streben nach Technologiesouveränität zielt darauf ab, einseitige Abhängigkeiten bei Schlüsseltechnologien abzubauen.
example_sentence.ar: يَهْدِفُ سَعْيُ أُورُوبَّا نَحْوَ السِّيَادَةِ التِّكْنُولُوجِيَّةِ إِلَى تَفْكِيكِ التَّبَعِيَّاتِ أُحَادِيَّةِ الجَانِبِ فِي التِّقْنِيَّاتِ المِفْتَاحِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: Europe's pursuit of technological sovereignty aims to reduce unilateral dependencies in key technologies.

example_sentence.de: In der modernen Geopolitik entscheidet die Halbleiterdiplomatie über den Zugang zu fortschrittlichsten Mikrochips.
example_sentence.ar: تُحَدِّدُ دِبْلُومَاسِيَّةُ أَشْبَاهِ المُوصِلَاتِ فِي الجِيُوسِيَاسَةِ الحَدِيثَةِ إِمْكَانِيَّةَ الوُصُولِ إِلَى الرَّقَائِقِ الإِلِكْتُرُونِيَّةِ الأَكْثَرِ تَقَدُّمًا.
example_sentence.en: In contemporary geopolitics, semiconductor diplomacy determines access to the most advanced microchips.

example_sentence.de: Ohne eigene Cloud-Infrastrukturen bleibt die strategische Autonomie eines Staates eine leere Hülle.
example_sentence.ar: تَبْقَى الاسْتِقْلَالِيَّةُ الاسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةُ لِلدَّوْلَةِ شِعَارًا أَجْوَفَ دُونَ امْتِلَاكِ بُنًى تَحْتِيَّةٍ سَحَابِيَّةٍ سِيَادِيَّةٍ.
example_sentence.en: Without indigenous cloud infrastructures, a nation's strategic autonomy remains an empty slogan.

example_sentence.de: Die technologische Entkopplung zwischen Großmächten führt zur Fragmentierung globaler Lieferketten.
example_sentence.ar: يُؤَدِّي فَكُّ الارْتِبَاطِ التِّكْنُولُوجِيِّ بَيْنَ القُوَى العُظْمَى إِلَى تَشَظِّي سَلَاسِلِ التَّوْرِيدِ العَالَمِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: Technological decoupling between major powers leads to the fragmentation of global supply chains.

example_sentence.de: Cyberangriffe auf die kritische Infrastruktur wie Stromnetze gelten als existenzielle Bedrohung nationaler Sicherheit.
example_sentence.ar: تُعَدُّ الهَجَمَاتُ السَّيْبِرَانِيَّةُ عَلَى البِنْيَةِ التَّحْتِيَّةِ الحَيَوِيَّةِ كَشَبَكَاتِ الكَهْرُبَاءِ تَهْدِيدًا وُجُودِيًّا لِلأَمْنِ القَوْمِيِّ.
example_sentence.en: Cyberattacks on critical infrastructure such as power grids are regarded as existential threats to national security.

example_sentence.de: Moderne Cyberkriegsführung zielt auf die Destabilisierung staatlicher Institutionen unterhalb der Kriegsschwelle.
example_sentence.ar: تَسْتَهْدِفُ الحَرْبُ السَّيْبِرَانِيَّةُ الحَدِيثَةُ زَعْزَعَةَ اسْتِقْرَارِ مُؤَسَّسَاتِ الدَّوْلَةِ دُونَ بُلُوغِ عَتَبَةِ الحَرْبِ التَّقْلِيدِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: Modern cyber warfare aims to destabilize state institutions below the traditional threshold of armed conflict.

example_sentence.de: Durch das Monopol auf lithografische Extrem-Ultraviolett-Anlagen beherrscht ein einzelner Konzern einen globalen Choke Point.
example_sentence.ar: مِنْ خِلَالِ احْتِكَارِ أَنْظِمَةِ الطِّبَاعَةِ الضَّوْئِيَّةِ بِالأَشِعَّةِ فَوْقَ البَنَفْسَجِيَّةِ، تُهَيْمِنُ شَرِكَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ عَلَى نُقْطَةِ اخْتِنَاقٍ عَالَمِيَّةٍ.
example_sentence.en: Through its monopoly on extreme ultraviolet lithography systems, a single corporation controls a global technological choke point.

example_sentence.de: Zunehmender Datennationalismus zwingt multinationale Konzerne, Serverfarmen strikt innerhalb nationaler Grenzen zu betreiben.
example_sentence.ar: تَفْرِضُ القَوْمِيَّةُ البَيَانِيَّةُ المُتَصَاعِدَةُ عَلَى الشَّرِكَاتِ عَابِرَةِ القَارَّاتِ تَشْغِيلَ خَوَادِمِ البَيَانَاتِ حَصْرِيًّا دَاخِلَ الحُدُودِ الوَطَنِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: Rising data nationalism forces multinational corporations to operate server farms strictly within national borders.

example_sentence.de: Die Plattformmacht von Big-Tech-Konzernen fordert das klassische staatliche Monopol auf Rechtsdurchsetzung heraus.
example_sentence.ar: يَتَحَدَّى نُفُوذُ المَنَصَّاتِ الرَّقْمِيَّةِ لِعَمَالِقَةِ التِّكْنُولُوجْيَا احْتِكَارَ الدَّوْلَةِ التَّقْلِيدِيَّ لِإِنْفَاذِ القَوَانِينِ.
example_sentence.en: The platform power of Big Tech corporations challenges the traditional state monopoly on legal enforcement.

example_sentence.de: Strenge Exportkontrollen für hochentwickelte Grafikprozessoren dienen der Verlangsamung fremder militärischer KI-Fähigkeiten.
example_sentence.ar: تُسْتَخْدَمُ مُرَاقَبَةُ الصَّادِرَاتِ الصَّارِمَةُ لِمُعَالِجَاتِ الرُّسُومِيَّاتِ المُتَقَدِّمَةِ لِإِبْطَاءِ القُدُرَاتِ العَسْكَرِيَّةِ لِلذَّكَاءِ الاصْطِنَاعِيِّ لَدَى الخُصُومِ.
example_sentence.en: Strict export controls on advanced graphics processors are used to decelerate adversaries' military AI capabilities.

example_sentence.de: Mehr als 95 Prozent des weltweiten Internetverkehrs fließen durch das verwundbare Unterseekabelnetzwerk.
example_sentence.ar: يَتَدَفَّقُ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ 95 بِالمِئَةِ مِنْ حَرَكَةِ الإِنْتَرْنِتِ العَالَمِيَّةِ عَبْرَ شَبَكَةِ الكَابِلَاتِ البَحْرِيَّةِ سَرِيعَةِ التَّأَثُّرِ.
example_sentence.en: Over 95 percent of global internet traffic travels through the vulnerable undersea cable network.

example_sentence.de: Im asymmetrischen Informationskrieg untergraben koordinierte Botnetze das Vertrauen der Bürger in demokratische Wahlen.
example_sentence.ar: تُقَوِّضُ شَبَكَاتُ الحِسَابَاتِ الوَهْمِيَّةِ المُنَسَّقَةُ فِي حَرْبِ المَعْلُومَاتِ غَيْرِ المُتَنَاظِرَةِ ثِقَةَ المُواطِنِينَ فِي الانْتِخَابَاتِ الدِّيمُقْرَاطِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: In asymmetric information warfare, coordinated bot networks undermine citizens' trust in democratic elections.

example_sentence.de: Demokratische Staaten bilden eine KI-Allianz zur Definition ethischer und sicherheitspolitischer Standards.
example_sentence.ar: تُشَكِّلُ الدُّوَلُ الدِّيمُقْرَاطِيَّةُ تَحَالُفًا لِلذَّكَاءِ الاصْطِنَاعِيِّ لِتَحْدِيدِ المَعَايِيرِ الأَخْلَاقِيَّةِ وَالأَمْنِيَّةِ لِلتَّطْوِيرِ.
example_sentence.en: Democratic states form an AI alliance to establish ethical and security standards for deployment.

example_sentence.de: Technologische Resilienz erfordert redundante Systeme und diversifizierte Zulieferer für essenzielle Komponenten.
example_sentence.ar: تَتَطَلَّبُ المُرُونَةُ التِّكْنُولُوجِيَّةُ أَنْظِمَةً احْتِيَاطِيَّةً مُتَعَدِّدَةً وَمُوَرِّدِينَ مُتَنَوِّعِينَ لِلْمُكَوِّنَاتِ الجَوْهَرِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: Technological resilience requires redundant systems and diversified suppliers for essential components.

example_sentence.de: Private Satellitenkonstellationen im erdnahen Orbit garantieren krisenfeste Breitbandkommunikation in Kriegsgebieten.
example_sentence.ar: تَضْمَنُ الكَوْكَبَاتُ السَّاتِلِيَّةُ الخَاصَّةُ فِي المَدَارِ المُنْخَفِضِ اتِّصَالَاتِ حُزْمَةٍ عَرِيضَةٍ صَامِدَةً فِي مَنَاطِقِ النِّزَاعِ.
example_sentence.en: Private low-Earth orbit satellite constellations guarantee resilient broadband communication in conflict zones.

example_sentence.de: Das globale Quantenwettrennen entscheidet darüber, welche Nation zuerst gegenwärtige Verschlüsselungen brechen kann.
example_sentence.ar: يُحَدِّدُ سِبَاقُ التَّسَلُّحِ الكَمِّيِّ العَالَمِيُّ الدَّوْلَةَ الَّتِي سَتَتَمَكَّنُ أَوَّلًا مِنْ كَسْرِ أَنْظِمَةِ التَّشْفِيرِ الحَالِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: The global quantum race will determine which nation can first break current cryptographic standards.

example_sentence.de: Nationale Firewalls und Zensurregime beschleunigen das Internet-Splitting in isolierte digitale Sphären.
example_sentence.ar: تُسَرِّعُ جُدْرَانُ الحِمَايَةِ القَوْمِيَّةُ وَأَنْظِمَةُ الرَّقَابَةِ تَجْزِئَةَ الإِنْتَرْنِتِ إِلَى مَجَالَاتٍ رَقْمِيَّةٍ مَعْزُولَةٍ.
example_sentence.en: National firewalls and censorship regimes accelerate splinternet fragmentation into isolated digital spheres.

example_sentence.de: Ein Cyberabwehrbündnis verpflichtet die Partner zur sofortigen gemeinsamen Abwehr großangelegter digitaler Angriffe.
example_sentence.ar: يُلْزِمُ حِلْفُ الدِّفَاعِ السَّيْبِرَانِيِّ الشُّرَكَاءَ بِالتَّصَدِّي الجَمَاعِيِّ الفَوْرِيِّ لِلْهَجَمَاتِ الرَّقْمِيَّةِ وَاسِعَةِ النِّطَاقِ.
example_sentence.en: A cyber defense alliance obligates partners to mount an immediate collective defense against large-scale digital attacks.

example_sentence.de: Die algorithmische Geopolitik analysiert, wie Empfehlungsalgorithmen Meinungsströme in fremden Nationen steuern.
example_sentence.ar: تُحَلِّلُ الجِيُوسِيَاسَةُ الخُوَارِزْمِيَّةُ كَيْفِيَّةَ تَوْجِيهِ خُوَارِزْمِيَّاتِ التَّوْصِيَةِ لِتَيَّارَاتِ الرَّأْيِ العَامِّ فِي الدُّوَلِ الأُخْرَى.
example_sentence.en: Algorithmic geopolitics analyzes how recommendation algorithms shape public opinion currents in foreign nations.

example_sentence.de: Die neue Sanktionsarchitektur schneidet den Aggressor vom Zugang zu westlicher Hochtechnologie ab.
example_sentence.ar: تَقْطَعُ مِعْمَارِيَّةُ العُقُوبَاتِ الجَدِيدَةُ إِمْكَانِيَّةَ وُصُولِ المُعْتَدِي إِلَى التِّقْنِيَّاتِ الغَرْبِيَّةِ الفَائِقَةِ.
example_sentence.en: The new sanctions architecture cuts off the aggressor from access to advanced Western technology.

example_sentence.de: Ein digitales Grenzregime filtert Datenströme an virtuellen Kontrollpunkten nach sicherheitspolitischen Kriterien.
example_sentence.ar: يَقُومُ نِظَامُ الحُدُودِ الرَّقْمِيَّةِ بِفَلْتَرَةِ تَدَفُّقَاتِ البَيَانَاتِ عِنْدَ نِقَاطِ تَمْرِيرٍ افْتِرَاضِيَّةٍ وَفْقَ مَعَايِيرَ أَمْنِيَّةٍ.
example_sentence.en: A digital border regime filters data flows at virtual checkpoints according to national security criteria.

example_sentence.de: Die NATO hat den Cyberraum offiziell als eigenständige militärische Operationsdomäne anerkannt.
example_sentence.ar: اعْتَرَفَ حِلْفُ النَّاتُو رَسْمِيًّا بِالفَضَاءِ السَّيْبِرَانِيِّ كَمَجَالِ عَمَلِيَّاتٍ عَسْكَرِيَّةٍ مُسْتَقِلٍّ بِذَاتِهِ.
example_sentence.en: NATO has officially recognized cyberspace as an independent military operational domain.

example_sentence.de: Das neue Datensouveränitätsgesetz verbietet den Transfer sensibler Bürgerdaten in ungesicherte Drittstaaten.
example_sentence.ar: يَحْظُرُ قَانُونُ سِيَادَةِ البَيَانَاتِ الجَدِيدُ نَقْلَ البَيَانَاتِ الحَسَّاسَةِ لِلْمُواطِنِينَ إِلَى دُوَلٍ ثَالِثَةٍ غَيْرِ آمِنَةٍ.
example_sentence.en: The new data sovereignty act prohibits the transfer of sensitive citizen data to unsecured third countries.

example_sentence.de: Im globalen Tech-Krieg sind geistiges Eigentum und seltene Erden die entscheidenden strategischen Ressourcen.
example_sentence.ar: تُمَثِّلُ المِلْكِيَّةُ الفِكْرِيَّةُ وَالعَنَاصِرُ الأَرْضِيَّةُ النَّادِرَةُ المَوَارِدَ الاسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةَ الحَاسِمَةَ فِي الحَرْبِ التِّكْنُولُوجِيَّةِ العَالَمِيَّةِ.
example_sentence.en: In the global tech war, intellectual property and rare earth elements constitute the critical strategic assets.
